messages.subject: INFO.filter default
parts:
Good morning,

Just a quick question... Why does the INFO filter default change from INFO > 0.9 in the first steps to INFO > 0.6 in later steps? Is there a reason or rationale for this change or just filter preferences?

Thanks,
Moreh

messages.author: 0b5254eeb9973d7a
messages.subject: Re: INFO.filter default
parts: More strict INFO filters are common for LDSC than for GWAS. Poor imputation can bias LDSC estimates for S, which are otherwise expected to be relatively unbiased. Lower quality imputation for GWAS is typically more tolerated because, although power for discovery is reduced relative to directly tagged or well-imputed variants, power is increased relative to removing the SNP entirely.
